findings.fix: Delete `stdPeterWeylCoeff` and the five duplicate lemmas. findings.issue: `stdPeterWeylCoeff 𝕜 G f x := peterWeylCoeff (IrrepClass.model) f x` — same type, same value, opaque body, no value lemma. Its dependent lemmas duplicate the general API verbatim modulo the name: `hasSum_stdPeterWeyl_expansion` (723), `tsum_star_stdPeterWeylCoeff_mul_stdPeterWeylCoeff` (730), `hasSum_norm_sq_stdPeterWeylCoeff` (738), `tsum_norm_sq_stdPeterWeylCoeff` (744), `summable_norm_sq_stdPeterWeylCoeff` (750). Consumers must detour through `repr_apply_apply` + `coe_stdPeterWeylBasis` + `peterWeylCoeff_eq_inner` to see it is the same coefficient. Docstring lines 92 and 110-111 present it as a distinct coefficient.

summary: `stdPeterWeylCoeff` is a definitionally identical duplicate of `peterWeylCoeff (IrrepClass.model)`, and five of its lemmas restate the general ones at `isIrrepSkeleton_model`; the only effect of the wrapper is to give the same value an opaque second name. Deleting it reconciles this thread with the reuse thread; `peterWeylCoeff_def` should stay, since `peterWeylCoeff` is a real definition with an unexposed body and `_def` is its characteristic lemma.
